captions.detailed: A portable travel blender consisting of a black cylindrical motor base, a transparent cylindrical blending cup, and a black lid with a flip-open spout. Inside the bottom of the cup, a multi-blade steel assembly is mounted on a central axis. The blade assembly rotates continuously on a vertical axis, while the spout cover at the top lid flips open via a horizontal revolute hinge.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a portable travel blender with a black cylindrical base, a transparent cup, a rotating blade assembly at the bottom, and a black lid with a flip-open drinking spout hinge.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a cylinder primitive. Create the cup by lofting or combining cylinders with a hollowed center, applying a semi-transparent material. Model the blade assembly using crossed rectangular boxes rotated around the Z-axis, and attach it to the base via a continuous joint. Create the lid as a flat cylinder, and add a spout cover block linked to the lid with a revolute joint.
